'''Mapes Shaywa''' was the chief of [[FiggEx Security]] and a member of the black-ops squad under [[Figg Excavations/Legends|FiggEx]].

==Biography==
As part of a plot to free themselves from the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]], FiggEx charged Shaywa with hiring [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] to hit their shipping lanes. Under the alias "Barseth Gynes", he sent an operative to contact [[Nogo Sistek]], who in turn located and bankrolled the pirates [[Salmakk]] and [[Clabburn the Younger|Clabburn]]. Unfortunately, the pirates' activity drew the attention of the [[Outer Javin Company]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], among others. Shaywa's mission then became to eliminate the pirates, as well as any evidence linking either himself or FiggEx to the operation.

His ultimate fate was unknown, but rumors existed that he was killed in a traffic accident on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gerrenthum/Legends|Gerrenthum]] shortly after the pirate incident.
